limitations: All seats use the same policy; these are not head-to-head matches.
Development maps were reused for implementation; the holdout seed was registered before its first runs.
The two confidence maps were selected because they had the most counter deaths.
Full-turn timing includes bot queries, command execution and diagnostics; it is not FPS or only tactical scoring.
Other work on this machine was not controlled; timing variance is large, so all repeats are retained.
Final coverage memo reproduces V6 commands and state on all three saved-turn fixtures; V6 supplies the whole-game cohort.
Counter deaths are reviewed original scores, not a proof that each unit could have escaped.
The enemy response is an estimate; projected moves can change paths, and a capped enemy shortlist can omit threats.
No swaps, no multi-unit response search, no default promotion, no server update, and no new balance run.
